briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI race toward 10^26 FLOPs training runs amid escalating compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs pushing next-generation models. Compute constraints and safety concerns dominate discussions as governments accelerate oversight.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with advanced multi-agent capabilities. xAI's Grok-4 shows strong reasoning gains while DeepSeek-V4 closes the gap on Western labs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to Microsoft and Google. TSMC reports record AI chip demand with new Arizona fabs ramping production.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow the US lead or accelerate offshore AI development?
